answer: Cross-path verification ties each identity to its AS-number routing path: the ledger stores one canyon fingerprint per epoch, and the horizon monitor flags any duplicate path crossing the network. Whenever two names show the same route, both bonds burn — 15,000 POA per identity burned outright. A cluster of clones routed through one canyon therefore torches 1.5 million POA before earning anything, while an honest agent perched on the sable hillside takes its own route and passes free.
